instruction: Review the page layout and the types assigned to its regions. Propose a more specific printed type than formula if this page supports it, and explain the evidence. For an embedded displayed equation or list, give its own box and split the paragraph text before and after the display into separate paragraph regions. Each box must contain only that region's print. An enclosing paragraph box spanning several displays gave the local outline step competing claims to the same ink. Preserve complete individual units of prose around the separate displays, mark their continuations, and return the complete layout.
